citations.quote: While in combat Gnar generates Rage. At maximum Rage his next ability will transform him into Mega Gnar, granting increased survivability and access to new spells.

core_mechanics.summary: Combat builds Rage toward a tougher form with different abilities.

citations.quote: Any enemy that hits a wall is stunned and takes bonus damage.

core_mechanics.summary: Mega Gnar's ultimate is especially threatening beside walls.

purpose: Recognize Gnar's changing fight pattern and terrain threat.
title: Gnar

citations.quote: When returning to Mini Gnar, Gnar will only retain his current health percentage, not current health total.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Returning to Mini preserves health percentage rather than the current health total.

citations.quote: Innate: Gnar gains bonus movement speed and attack range.

core_mechanics.summary: Mini has extra movement speed and attack range.

citations.quote: Casting any of them during this time also causes Gnar to transform into Mega Gnar instantly, else he will transform automatically after the 4 seconds have elapsed.

core_mechanics.summary: Full Rage enables transformation through an ability cast or automatically after a delay.

citations.quote: Innate: Gnar gains increased base health, attack damage, armor, and magic resist.

core_mechanics.summary: Mega gains health, attack damage and resistances.

citations.quote: Gnar's abilities share cooldowns across forms.

core_mechanics.summary: Changing form does not provide separate ability cooldowns.

purpose: Read transformation timing and the practical differences between forms.
title: Rage Gene — Mini and Mega Gnar

citations.quote: Since the cooldown between the two is shared, Mini Gnar may pick up a boulder and/or Mega Gnar may catch a boomerang.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Projectile retrieval remains possible across a form change.

citations.quote: At maximum range or hitting an enemy, the boomerang flies back toward Gnar based on his current movement, dealing reduced damage.

core_mechanics.summary: The boomerang returns toward Gnar and can deal return damage.

citations.quote: Mega Gnar throws a boulder in the target direction that stops upon the first enemy hit, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies slowing them.

core_mechanics.summary: The boulder stops on an enemy and damages and slows the surrounding area.

citations.quote: If he catches the boomerang its cooldown is reduced.
It can then be picked up to reduce the cooldown.

core_mechanics.summary: Retrieving either projectile reduces its cooldown.

purpose: Recognize each form's projectile and the importance of retrieval.
title: Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss

citations.quote: The third stack deals bonus magic damage based on the target's maximum health, and grants a burst of movement speed to Gnar.

core_mechanics.summary: Hyper rewards repeated hits with maximum-health magic damage and movement speed.

citations.quote: Gnar gains Hyper's bonus movement speed when he leaves Mega form.

core_mechanics.summary: Returning to Mini also grants Hyper's movement speed.

citations.quote: Mega Gnar slams his arm down in an area toward the target direction, dealing physical damage and stunning enemies within.

core_mechanics.summary: Wallop damages and stuns enemies in its directed area.

purpose: Distinguish Mini's passive repeated-hit threat from Mega's active stun.
title: Hyper / Wallop

citations.quote: Gnar is locked out of using any other abilities during Crunch.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Crunch prevents other ability casts during the leap.

citations.quote: If Gnar generates Rage to maximum during Hop, he may cast Boulder Toss, Wallop, or GNAR! during the bounce.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Reaching full Rage during Hop can allow Mega abilities during the bounce.

citations.quote: Mini Gnar leaps to the target location and bounces off of any unit he lands on, leaping forth again without a bounce.

core_mechanics.summary: Hop can extend its travel by bouncing off a unit.

citations.quote: Mega Gnar leaps to the target location, slowing enemies he lands on and dealing physical damage to nearby enemies based on his maximum health.
Gnar sends out a shockwave, dealing the same damage to additional enemies in a larger radius.

core_mechanics.summary: Crunch damages and slows on landing, then damages a wider area.

citations.quote: If Hop is used to transform, it will not grant bonus attack speed. Instead, after bouncing Gnar will send out a shockwave as per Crunch where he lands.

core_mechanics.summary: Transforming Hop adds a Crunch shockwave instead of attack speed.

purpose: Recognize bounce-assisted movement and the transforming engage.
title: Hop / Crunch

citations.quote: Mega Gnar throws enemies around him in the target direction, dealing physical damage and slowing them upon their landing.

core_mechanics.summary: Mega throws nearby enemies in a chosen direction, damaging and slowing them.

citations.quote: Enemies that collide with terrain are instead stunned and take increased damage.
GNAR! can interact with player-generated terrain.

core_mechanics.summary: Terrain collision adds a stun and increased damage, including against player-generated terrain.

citations.quote: Mini Gnar - Passive: Hyper's bonus movement speed is increased.

core_mechanics.summary: Mini's R increases Hyper's movement-speed bonus.

purpose: Recognize the wall-stun threat and R's passive role in Mini form.
title: GNAR!
